mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the owner-or-admin guard lets a non-owner member be the caller on an allowed PATCH/DELETE; the injection forces exactly that case.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipBypass { some op: Operation | op.oAllowed = TrueB and op.oKind = PatchTask and op.oCallerRole = MemberRole and some op.oTarget and op.oTarget.tOwner != op.oCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing cross-team isolation permits an allowed op whose target task belongs to a team other than the caller's X-Team-Id; we use a GET-by-id (no audit) so this doesn't collide with audit-team-link facts.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeak { some op: Operation | op.oAllowed = TrueB and op.oKind = GetTaskById and some op.oTarget and op.oTarget.tTeam != op.oTeamCtx }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the per-edit audit constraint allows a successful POST/PATCH/DELETE without a paired audit entry; the injection forces that gap to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some op: Operation | op.oAllowed = TrueB and op.oKind = PostTasks and no op.oAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the append-only fact, an AuditEntry can exist with no originating Operation (an orphan, the structural analogue of a tampered-in or stranded row).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | no op: Operation | op.oAudit = ae }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing attribution lets an audit entry record an actor different from the operation's caller — i.e., misattribution; the injection forces that mismatch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_Misattribution { some op: Operation | some op.oAudit and op.oAudit.aActor != op.oCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: With the matrix unconstrained, an allowed operation can use a (role, kind) cell that isn't in PermMatrix.Allowed; the injection forces both: an allowed op and a matrix that doesn't grant its cell.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UngroundedAllow { some op: Operation | op.oAllowed = TrueB and (op.oCallerRole -> op.oKind) not in PermMatrix.Allowed }
